grant_awarding_organization: User-defined hypothetical scenario; RVO eligibility and award not verified

financial_basis.performance_improvements: None: original modeled sales and OPEX; no assumed cost reductions or revenue/yield uplifts.
financial_basis.capex_basis: high direct uninstalled equipment CAPEX from current cost register; digester tank at €1,800/m3
financial_basis.operating_premium_basis: Dynamic per-candidate biomethane output (annual biomethane kg divided by 0.716 kg/Nm3 at 0 degC and 101.325 kPa) multiplied by the average user-specified value of €1.87/Nm3; nominal support applied for 15 years. This is a scenario proxy, not an official SDE++ award calculation; sensitivity range €1.28–€2.46/Nm3 is retained for later analysis.
financial_basis.npv_basis: After-tax constant-account screening NPV using Configure defaults; no financing, escalation, replacement, working capital, residual value or installed-CAPEX factor unless explicitly entered.

carbon_basis.boundary: operational process inventory plus upstream life-cycle utility supply-chain emissions
carbon_basis.net_carbon_definition: Modeled inventory climate load × 12/44 minus retained product carbon, t C/year.
carbon_basis.fiber_fate: 100% of modeled press-cake carbon assumed in furniture over 20 years; manufacturing loss and end-of-life excluded.
carbon_basis.soil_fate: 10% of modeled nutrient-rich-solids carbon retained in soil as an explicit screening assumption.
carbon_basis.protein_carbon_credit: none; protein may be fed or used as biostimulant and no split/retention rate is specified.
excluded: downstream product use except stated product-carbon stock

biomethane_support_conversion.calculation: candidate biomethane kg/year ÷ density × average value per Nm3; candidate-specific annual volume is used
biomethane_support_conversion.standard_conditions: Nm3 at 0 degC and 101.325 kPa; biomethane treated as methane for mass-volume conversion
biomethane_support_conversion.caveat: Screening overlay only; actual SDE++ support depends on eligible biomethane injection and annual correction amounts.

grass_utilization_bonus.label: Grass utilization/logistics bonus
grass_utilization_bonus.status: User-defined hypothetical support; not an awarded subsidy
grass_utilization_bonus.basis: Rate × annual wet tonnes actually processed; post-route economics only; no process chemistry, balances, or emissions change.

product_eligibility.rule: At least one model-reported saleable recovery-product annual flow must exceed 1e-9 in the reported product basis. Productless route cases are retained as rejected samples and excluded from fronts.

limitations: Original modeled sales and partial OPEX are used unchanged; no assumed labour, logistics or energy savings, protein-yield or nutrient-recovery revenue uplifts are applied.
C30/C45/C60/C0 CAPEX grant fractions are user-defined what-if values, not awards or verified RVO eligibility determinations.

The OPEX overlay multiplies each candidate's modeled biomethane volume by the average €1.87/Nm3 value; €1.28–€2.46/Nm3 is retained as a later sensitivity range. This is not a verified RVO tariff or guaranteed support.
RVO DEI+ eligibility, eligible cost base, grant ceiling and co-funding conditions are not assessed.
RVO SDE++ support is modeled from each candidate's biomethane output for 15 years without official annual market corrections or an eligibility test.
CAPEX is high direct uninstalled screening cost; installation and unpriced/uncosted components may be missing.
OPEX remains partial; NPV is an after-tax screening proxy under the shared Configure assumptions, not an investment-grade forecast.
Operational climate inventory is limited to electricity, heat, and modeled process emissions at the stated factors.
Net carbon includes assumed furniture and soil carbon retention; no manufacturing loss or end-of-life release is represented.
The fronts are bounded by the sampled configurations and are not global optima.

feed_composition_profile.basis: wet mass fraction; mass fractions sum to 1

input_provenance.full_ledger_note: Projection recalculated from saved process runs; source full JSON and batch ledgers were not rewritten because they exceed available workspace capacity.

lca.boundary: operational process inventory plus upstream life-cycle utility supply-chain emissions

exclusions.materials: Upstream non-energy material production is outside the boundary; electricity supply-chain emissions are included in the JRC lifecycle factor.
exclusions.transport: Offsite feedstock and product transport is excluded.
exclusions.storage_emissions: Storage emissions are excluded from this operational boundary; separate storage modelling is not characterized here.
exclusions.feedstock_production: Cultivation and land-use change are excluded.

electricity.note: Modeled annual electricity activity; JRC 2021 Dutch lifecycle factor includes upstream electricity supply.

heat.note: Modeled annual process heat activity; CE Delft 2022 Dutch end-user heat-grid average applied (literature evidence, not site-specific).

process_emissions.note: Modeled vented process methane and gas flows; terminal gas fate set to emitted for this screening case.

electricity.basis: JRC life-cycle electricity factor 0.406463 t CO2e/MWh, converted numerically to 0.406463 kg CO2e/kWh; includes upstream electricity supply-chain emissions.
electricity.applicability: National Netherlands consumption mix; appropriate as a lifecycle grid factor, not a site-specific supplier factor. Published time series ends in 2021.
electricity.uncertainty: Dataset point estimate; no probability distribution imposed. Do not interpret year-to-year variation as a confidence interval.

heat.basis: CE Delft reports 30.96 kg CO2e/GJ total end-user heat factor for Dutch heat grids in 2022 (direct emissions plus supply-chain emissions); converted using 1 GJ = 277.7778 kWh.
heat.source_table_page: CE Delft publication summary, end-user total heat factor for 2022
heat.applicability: Dutch average heat-grid factor based on reported 2022 heat-source deployment; not a site- or supplier-specific network factor.
heat.uncertainty: Published national average; source page does not provide a probability distribution. Do not treat this point estimate as site-specific.

electricity.note: Modeled annual electricity activity; JRC 2021 Dutch lifecycle factor includes upstream electricity supply.

electricity.uncertainty: Dataset point estimate; no probability distribution imposed. Do not interpret year-to-year variation as a confidence interval.

heat.basis: CE Delft reports 30.96 kg CO2e/GJ total end-user heat factor for Dutch heat grids in 2022 (direct emissions plus supply-chain emissions); converted using 1 GJ = 277.7778 kWh.

heat.applicability: Dutch average heat-grid factor based on reported 2022 heat-source deployment; not a site- or supplier-specific network factor.

heat.applicability: Dutch average heat-grid factor based on reported 2022 heat-source deployment; not a site- or supplier-specific network factor.

heat.basis: CE Delft reports 30.96 kg CO2e/GJ total end-user heat factor for Dutch heat grids in 2022 (direct emissions plus supply-chain emissions); converted using 1 GJ = 277.7778 kWh.
